hero.label: Made for Readily
hero.headline: I want to help Readily turn healthcare compliance chaos into clarity.
hero.subheadline: Readily is attacking a real, expensive problem: 30% of U.S. healthcare costs are administrative, and compliance is a massive piece of that. The idea of owning the post-sale journey for billion-dollar health plans using AI to cut audit work by 90% is genuinely exciting to me. I want to be the person who makes sure those organizations actually get there.

whyCompany.title: 90% reduction in compliance work is a product that sells itself
whyCompany.body: When a product saves health plans that much time and money, customer success becomes less about convincing people to stay and more about helping them go deeper. That is the kind of CSM role I want to be in. The value is real, and my job is to make sure customers feel every bit of it.

whyCompany.title: Readily is building the CS function from scratch right now
whyCompany.body: Readily has 14 people and is hiring for 7 roles simultaneously, including this one. That means whoever joins is not inheriting a playbook, they are writing it. For a 21-year-old who wants to grow fast, there is no better environment than a YC-backed team at exactly this stage.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and B2B marketing roots fit the post-sale motion here
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran outbound sequences and helped close 15 to 20 paying clients, so I understand what was promised before the contract was signed. At NextAfter I worked inside a B2B consultancy learning how clients measure results and where they get stuck. That combination means I can bridge what sales sold and what success actually looks like.

quote: Healthcare compliance is one of those problems where the stakes are real and the inefficiency is staggering. I want to be the person at Readily who makes sure customers actually get to 90% time savings, not just on paper but in their day-to-day work.
